summary: Local, service-first workflow for generating source-backed first-pass environmental constraints review packages for mandatory human review.

notes: Command Center registration is manual from Settings by repository path; this manifest does not create registry membership.
V1.0 is implementation-complete. Current work should be testing, verification, bug fixing, documentation correction, source/data validation, or explicitly approved new features.
The local web UI is local-first and unauthenticated; no hosted deployment or multi-user workflow is implemented.
The manifest follows a provisional Command Center V1 shape and should be reviewed when the final schema is implemented.
